observed_behavior: Supported route patterns produce the same dispatch and path values.
Controlled registration panics become typed compile errors without partial publication.
Default misses match ServeMux while enabled automatic OPTIONS is an explicit extension.
Origin and absolute forms dispatch while unsupported authority and asterisk forms are rejected.
Default canonical redirects match ServeMux and the defensive rejection option preserves escaped structure.
Literal host matching is preserved while bounded single-label wildcards are a documented extension.
Mount stripping uses a cloned URL and retains escaped suffix structure rather than mutating the caller request.
Path values remain on the standard request while route metadata is a bounded copied extension.
Generated segment values round-trip through ServeMux without structural injection.
Absolute URLs use explicit validated bases and never infer proxy or request authority.
